theorem.name: PostAlphaPrimitiveClassNoSplitImportTheorem
theorem.statement: The selected primitive fixed-fiber quotient class is enough for current C1 spectral observables but cannot by itself produce flavor splitting. Direct replay gives Y_s Y_s* = c I in u,d,e,nuD, with zero traceless parts, zero sector commutators, and zero CP-odd content. Therefore nondegenerate Yukawa hierarchy, CKM/PMNS/CP, A_selected, b_selected, and lambda_12 require selected same-source higher-order/full-response matrix emission or selected operator-level basis transport.

primitive_layer_tests.reason: At the current primitive fixed-fiber quotient layer every sector has Y_s Y_s^* equal to the same scalar identity, so traceless splitting, sector commutators, and CP-odd invariants vanish.

acceptance_tests.CKM_or_PMNS: sector Hermitian corrections are not simultaneously diagonalizable
acceptance_tests.CP: selected complex correction data have nonzero CP-odd invariant
acceptance_tests.mass_splitting: traceless part of H_s^(r) = correction to Y_s Y_s* is nonzero
